results.name: mounted conversation rows for 10k history
results.justification: conversationList.test.ts keeps 3k and 10k histories under 80 mounted rows (viewport 900px, overscan 8).

results.name: row visits per streamed tail token at 10k
results.justification: A tail delta may only visit the mounted window, not retained history. Same 80-row bound as mounted rows.

results.name: visible events rebuilt per tail delta
results.justification: Incremental projection should rebuild the live tail. 8 is 4× a two-event append after a measured O(1) rebuild.

results.name: renderer deliveries for 1000 PTY chunks
results.justification: 1000×64-byte chunks are 64 KiB. 32 KiB MessagePort flushes imply a handful of posts; 16 is ~4× that plus replay.

results.name: live primary sessions after soak cleanup
results.justification: Soak create/close must release every session. 0 live primaries is the leak invariant.

results.name: tool-marker event loss
results.justification: Markers are uncoalesced. Expected 6 samples, got 6.

results.name: bridge sequence/order errors
results.justification: A completed replay already rejected generation changes and sequence gaps; a finished report is 0 errors.

results.name: transport pending events high-water
results.justification: Replay buffer is 4096 batches. Measured high-water must stay inside that cap (headroom is the cap minus the run’s peak).

results.name: transport pending bytes high-water
results.justification: Replay buffer is 32 MiB. Queue bytes are gated at that product cap.

results.name: slow-client disconnects
results.justification: A correct client in this harness must not trip the hard slow-client ceiling.

results.name: live primary sessions after replay
results.justification: Replay leaves sessions open. Count must equal the scenario’s 1 sessions, not grow past them.

results.name: history persistence overflow/degraded transitions
results.justification: Write-behind is capped at 50000 rows / 67108864 bytes. A normal replay must not overflow that bound.
